2. We are informed that the Petitioners are enjoying the bail and
have disobeyed Condition No. 3 of the bail order, dated 29th April, 2025.
3. We expressed our disinclination.
4. The  learned  Advocate  for  the  Petitioners  submits,  on
instructions, that the Petitioners desire to withdraw this Petition.
